scene_description: Wooden shelf top with curved wooden end panels against a gray wall. On the left, a green box sits tilted on top of the white box top. In the center, the white box lies on its side. On the right, the other green box is tipped up against the right end panel. Front is the open edge of the shelf.

targets.name: white box top
targets.description: White box top with blue handwritten 'HERBARIUM MICHAUX' on its front face, at the left end of the shelf, partly underneath the left green box.
targets.orientation: lying flat, closed top facing up
nearby_obstacles: Left green box resting on top of it
Left wooden end panel close to its left side
targets.clearance_notes: Only the front face and a strip on the left are exposed; the green box covers much of the top.

candidate_improvements.description: Lift the left green box off the box top and set it flat on the shelf to the right.

targets.other_notes: Overlap with the green box can't be measured from the photos.

targets.name: left green box
targets.description: Green cloth-covered box with a white interior, open side up on the left of the shelf, tilted because its left part rests on the white box top.
targets.orientation: tilted, open side up with the left side raised about 4 cm
nearby_obstacles: White box top underneath its left part
targets.clearance_notes: Top, front and right walls are exposed, but it is not level and may rock when pushed.

candidate_improvements.description: Move the green box right until it sits flat on the shelf, clear of the box top.

targets.name: white box
targets.description: White box lying on its side in the center of the shelf, open end facing right toward the tipped-up green box.
targets.orientation: lying on its side, open end facing right
nearby_obstacles: Tipped-up green box touching its right side
targets.clearance_notes: Top, front and left are exposed, with about 12 cm of shelf to its left.

candidate_improvements.description: Slide the white box approximately 5 cm left, away from the tipped-up green box.

targets.other_notes: Dimensions are for the box standing upright.

targets.name: right green box
targets.description: Green cloth-covered box at the right end of the shelf, tipped up and propped on top of the right wooden end panel, closed bottom facing up and outward.
targets.orientation: tipped up at an angle, open side facing the end panel
nearby_obstacles: Right wooden end panel supporting it
White box touching its lower-left edge
targets.clearance_notes: Bottom face and lower edge are exposed, but it is held up only by the end panel and may tip.

candidate_improvements.description: Lower the green box off the end panel and lay it flat on the shelf.

targets.other_notes: Only about 11 cm of shelf is free; other objects must shift first.

source: Staged permutation of S0013 and S0017, using the same objects in a different arrangement.
